items.title: Day 1 — BellaCiao channel opener (Bella intro to camera)

script.format: 9:16 vertical short, ~22s, single host to camera

lines.vo: Every restaurant you love is quietly fighting something you can't see.
I'm Bella. I spent years behind the pass — now I sit with the owners who feed their cities, from New York to Melbourne to London.
Each one's up against a different enemy: the algorithm, the rankings, the noise. This is where we name it — and beat it.

scenePrompts.shot: vertical chest-up, Bella addressing camera, just begun speaking, closed-lip half-smile
